name: Gl1_Cylinder
description:
Renders Cylinder object

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_Cylinder.wire(=false)

	Only show wireframe (controlled by ``glutSlices`` and ``glutStacks``.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_Cylinder.glutNormalize(=true)

	Fix normals for non-wire rendering

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_Cylinder.glutSlices(=8)

	Number of sphere slices.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_Cylinder.glutStacks(=4)

	Number of sphere stacks.
